subject: Genetics
title: The Patent Wars
description: A 60-second lesson on The Patent Wars.

hook.text: Can you own a human gene? Celera wanted to patent thousands. Public scientists were horrified.

buildup.text: Celera's business model was selling genome access. Patents on genes would give them monopoly over research.

discovery.text: The public project fought back with open access. Every base pair released freely made Celera's patents weaker.

twist.text: In 2013, the Supreme Court ruled natural genes cannot be patented. Myriad Genetics lost its BRCA gene monopoly.

climax.text: The ruling opened BRCA testing to all labs. Prices dropped 90%. Access won—but it took 20 years of legal battles.

punchline.text: You can't patent what nature wrote.

quiz.question: What did the 2013 Supreme Court rule about natural genes?
